description: This file contains the implementation of an Azure Queue Data Manager class that provides various methods for managing Azure Storage Queues, such as creating, deleting, clearing, adding messages, peeking, retrieving, deleting individual messages, and obtaining approximate message counts. It also includes default policies for queue operation retries and timeout settings, as well as logic for configuring queue options and validating queue names.

classes.name: AzureQueueDefaultPolicies
classes.description: Contains default static policies for maximum retries and timeouts for Azure Queue operations.

classes.name: AzureQueueDataManager
classes.description: Utility class to encapsulate access to Azure Queue storage, allowing initialization, message management, queue deletion, and retrieval of queue properties.

methods.name: AzureQueueDataManager(ILoggerFactory, string, string, TimeSpan?)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the queue manager with connection string and optional visibility timeout.

methods.name: AzureQueueDataManager(ILoggerFactory, string, AzureQueueOptions)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the queue manager with specified options.

methods.name: InitQueueAsync
methods.description: Initializes connection to the queue, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: DeleteQueue
methods.description: Deletes the queue if it exists.

methods.name: ClearQueue
methods.description: Clears all messages from the queue.

methods.name: AddQueueMessage
methods.description: Adds a message to the queue.

methods.name: PeekQueueMessage
methods.description: Peeks at the latest message without dequeuing it.

methods.name: GetQueueMessage
methods.description: Retrieves one message from the queue.

methods.name: GetQueueMessages
methods.description: Retrieves up to a specified number of messages from the queue.

methods.name: DeleteQueueMessage
methods.description: Deletes a specific message from the queue.

methods.name: GetAndDeleteQueueMessage
methods.description: Retrieves and deletes a message from the queue.

methods.name: GetApproximateMessageCount
methods.description: Returns an approximate count of messages in the queue.
